name: xTool S1
tagline: Enclosed diode laser — safer and cleaner than open-frame alternatives
tldr: The xTool S1 puts a 20W or 40W diode inside an enclosed cabinet with exhaust filtering. Much safer for home use than open-frame machines. Cutting performance is still diode-class — not CO₂ — but the enclosed design is a major upgrade for families and apartments.

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Fully enclosed — major safety and smoke improvement vs open-frame
Built-in exhaust filter option for apartment use
Same large work area as D1 Pro in a safer package
Camera alignment available on some configs
cons: Premium price over open-frame D1 Pro for similar diode performance
Still a diode — same material limits as D1 Pro
Filter cartridges need replacement over time
40W diode marketing — verify optical power for your variant
beginnerNotes: Choose S1 over D1 Pro if safety and smoke control matter more than saving money — especially with kids, pets, or neighbors. Skip if you need CO₂ cutting; this will not replace a P2.
proTips: Vent to window when cutting heavily even with filters — filters reduce smell but are not magic. Use the camera for batch alignment on repeat products. Pair with xTool riser for tumblers.
primaryUse: Enclosed hobby and light business diode laser for safer home engraving and moderate cutting.

faq.question: Is the xTool S1 safer than an open-frame laser?
faq.answer: Yes. The enclosure blocks direct beam exposure and contains smoke. You still follow safety rules, but accidental exposure risk is much lower than open-frame diodes.

faq.question: Can the S1 replace a CO₂ laser?
faq.answer: No. It is still a diode laser with the same acrylic and cutting limits. Buy CO₂ (like xTool P2) if clear acrylic and thick wood cutting are your main work.

mainObjective: Safer enclosed home engraving with cleaner smoke control
